svg.title: The farming axis, drawn
svg.desc: Six panels side by side, one per position, all drawn at the same scale because the axis does not depend on how big a project is. S0 Created agriculture: ground that was built on, its old foundations still showing through the sward, carrying a flock under the rows that no farm worked before. S1 Primary agriculture: the use the ground already carried, continued under wide rows. S2 Secondary agriculture: a farm still works it, at a lower value than before, as grazing. S3 Ordinary-land siting: an ordinary field taken, the farmstead beyond the fence still standing on the lease. S4 Low-productivity siting: the poor remnant taken and the good ground left working. S5 Impaired-land siting: ground carrying a burden, taken and planted against it. The tint runs deep blue at the sharing end through neutral at S3 to purple at the sparing end.
svg.text: a use that was not there
